summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting an ordinary share buyback on 17 April 2026. Through BNP Paribas SA, it purchased 330,000 shares at a volume-weighted average price of 2,126.15 GBp (range: 2,115.00p–2,137.00p). The shares will be held in treasury. This is part of an existing buyback programme announced on 17 February 2026; since then, 19,856,521 shares have been bought. Post-purchase, the company holds 259,747,615 treasury shares, representing 6.40% of voting rights. The filing provides detailed trade-by-trade execution data. Investors should monitor the remaining programme authorization and any impact on share count and voting rights.
